summary: 21 of 26 sub-steps present, 5 absent (L1, L2, P3, P4, S1), 0 wrong. The plan carries the bank-exchange network (B1-B4), the rank-saving numbers (R1-R4), the matrix-shear proof (M1-M4) and the guard-width derivation (S2-S5) in full; it omits the residual table (L1), the h-2 side-edge complement (L2), the k-column tensoring of the phase interface (P3), the endpoint frames and Z repair details (P4), and the definitions of nu and C_0 (S1).
